comment: Vulkan driver packages DOOM Mobile downloads when the phone is online (DmActivity.updateDriversInBackground). Each entry: name = folder under the app's drivers dir and the label in the settings, url = adrenotools package zip (meta.json + driver .so), sha256 = of that zip, auto = Java regex over /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_model (e.g. Adreno750v2) selecting the package by default when the user has not picked a driver. The bundled default is turnip27 (Adreno 6xx/7xx).

packages.name: turnip27-a8xx
packages.title: Mesa Turnip v27.0.0-20261029, Adreno 8xx / Snapdragon 8 Elite (experimental)

packages.title: Mesa Turnip v27.0.0-20261029, Adreno 740 on newer firmware (Samsung One UI); glitches elsewhere
